_: Sessions the office starts itself (src/server/dispatch.js, bin/office-turn.js, bin/office-spawn.js): Claude Code run headless from the office page, set up with a model, effort, hands and time cap before it starts. Every choice the page offers is in this file; a request naming anything else is refused. Change a model id here when a newer Claude model comes out.

hands.label: Careful
hands.hint: It works on its own; Claude Code turns down anything risky.

hands.label: Full
hands.hint: Like your own chats with every permission allowed: nothing is asked. Your hooks and deny rules still apply.

hands.label: Plan only
hands.hint: It reads and writes a plan. It changes nothing.

_presets: One tap on the New session sheet sets the model, effort, hands and cap together.

presets.label: Review
presets.hint: Fable 5.1 reads and judges; it changes nothing

presets.label: Research
presets.hint: Sonnet 5.5: look things up and write it down

_effort: Every default and every preset is medium effort; another effort is only ever the one picked on the New session sheet or named with office-spawn.js --effort.
_helper_defaults: What bin/office-spawn.js gives a helper when the lead names nothing: Opus on medium. A helper never runs above its lead's effort, and a Fable helper runs on low only (dispatch.js createJob), so a chain of helpers can't run up your usage.

limits._max_running: Turns running at once on this computer. A new session past it is refused in words; a note to an existing one waits until a turn ends.
limits._max_depth: A helper of a helper of a helper is the deepest: 1 is a session you started or one a chat handed work to.
limits._max_turns_per_hour: Per session. Past it notes wait and its chart says why: the brake on two sessions talking each other round in circles.
